and come from list-media {kind:"document"} or upload-media. "id" and "href" go in the comment; href is also the button's href and the preview's data. THE TWO LINKS Name link: file name. Its id is any value unique on the page (the editor writes wp-block-file--media-); the button's aria-describedby repeats it. Its href is the file url (or the attachment page). New tab: target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener". Button: Download; the bare "download" attribute is what marks it as the button. No button: "showDownloadButton": false in the comment and no second . No name link: drop the first and the button's aria-describedby.
